rationale: The Ybus matrix was constructed by first initializing a 3x3 matrix of zeros. For each of the three branches, the series admittance y = 1/(r+jx) was calculated. This value, plus half the line charging susceptance (j*b/2), was added to the diagonal entries corresponding to the branch's terminal buses. The negative of the series admittance (-y) was added to the corresponding off-diagonal entries. Finally, the shunt admittance (g+jb) at bus_3 was added to its diagonal entry. The resulting complex matrix was then formatted into the required JSON structure.
